_comment: Solstice paper-diorama style theme. Aligned with docs/art/ART-STYLE.md SS1-SS3. The batch tool assembles prompts from these fields rather than from hand-written strings, so the look stays consistent across every generated asset.

medium.zh: 多层剪纸纸雕微缩模型

words: flat matte surface, no specular highlight
four hard light bands, cel shaded
soft ambient occlusion between paper layers
tilt-shift macro photograph of a tabletop model
studio tabletop lighting from one direction
no text, no watermark, no signature
negative: depth of field blur on the subject

paper-texture.prompt: seamless tileable paper texture, unbleached kraft and warm off-white cardstock, faint horizontal grain, tiny fibre flecks, evenly lit, top-down flat scan

ground-texture.prompt: seamless tileable cut-paper ground surface, layered contour ribbons like a topographic relief map, thin inked level lines, kraft and moss tones, flat top-down view

water-texture.prompt: single sheet of pale blue translucent washi paper laid flat, gentle long wrinkles, no reflections, even light

card-face.prompt: front face of a small handmade card, portrait 3:4, thick deckled paper edge, an empty framed panel in the centre reserved for a symbol, tiny corner ornaments, warm ivory

license.note: All output must be logged in studio/out/manifest.jsonl for the storefront AI-content disclosure.
